en: Higher engineering skill allows you to learn higher level engineering schematics. Schematics can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
This tribe of exiled trolls has joined forces with Thrall and the Horde. They now call Durotar their home, which they share with their orc allies.
Rewards may be purchased at the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar.
Each week, the Rank Points cap is increased, up to a maximum of %s for Rank %s.
Honor is gained by killing members of the opposite faction in PVP combat. You can use honor points to purchase special items.
